liz: Short thread to decide: should fallthrough to cheaper quantized models surface as an error or metadata?
sam: Metadata only. apps will want to degrade gracefully. Erroring causes retries and increased load.
toni: Agree metadata, but we need a tiny enum for reasons: compat_mismatch, region_down, capacity_preempt. Keep it stable.
liz: Also add `served_model` + `requested_model` so SDKs can log and compare.
sam: Add `quality_score` (0-1) to help feature gating.
toni: On runtime side: single-pass evaluator with `max_hops=2` to avoid chained surprises. Record hop chain in telemetry but don't expose unless client asks.
liz: Billing: default bill at served_model. For special contracts expose `billing_override` flag in tenant config. Finance will want a report.
sam: Tests: sim run over 3 days of traces and a small eval set to ensure quality delta < 2.5% for fallthroughs.
toni: Ops: schedule a lightweight canary that only logs `meta` (no behavior change) behind feature flag. deploy-bot: canary scheduled 2026-04-12T08:00Z on us-east-1.
liz: I'll write RFC + proto sketch. will ping reviewers.
